name: Same item, two prices
evidence: own channel: this format produced about 1.2K views (31 Oct to 2 Nov 2026); no external study confirms it

hook.formula: Open on both prices: "{item}: {price_a} versus {price_b}. What is the difference?"

beats.text: Would you pay {price_b}? Comment yes or no.

captions: large centred captions in the safe zone, one short phrase at a time
cta: Would you pay {price_b}? Comment yes or no.
loopBack: Last line returns to the opening price pair.
rules: a new item every upload; never repost an item
every number needs a source before upload
